# AGS4 to DIGGS mapping (preview)

!!! warning "Preview: every group is a draft"
    This is mapping table **0.1**, used by `pydiggs.preview.convert.ags4_to_diggs`
    in pyDIGGS 1.9. Every group mapping is a draft until it is reviewed; mapping table 1.0
    is signed off with pyDIGGS 1.10, and until then a heading may move. Corrections from
    DIGGS and AGS practitioners are welcome: a mapping change is a small diff to the TOML
    files under `src/pydiggs/convert/mappings/`.

The converter writes DIGGS 3.0.0. It reads AGS4 4.0.3, 4.0.4, 4.1, 4.1.1, 4.2. No published AGS4 to DIGGS mapping
exists, so this table is original work. It holds only AGS4 group and heading names, keys
and parent groups; it copies nothing else from the AGS4 data dictionary.

Every non-null value of an AGS4 file is either carried into DIGGS or named by a
`convert` finding (see [Findings](findings.md#rule-ids)). A group that is not listed here
is reported as `convert.unmapped-group`; a heading that is listed as *not converted*, or
not listed at all, as `convert.unmapped-heading`; and anything the file's own `DICT`
group defines as `convert.user-defined`.

**Targets.** *key*: identifies the record; it becomes the `gml:id` (made a valid XML id)
and the `gml:name`. *link*: a key of the parent record, used to attach this record to it.
*field*: a value the converter places itself (named in the table). *param*: a DIGGS
element, as `Element/child`. *column*: a result column, named by its key in the
[DIGGS property dictionary](https://diggsml.org/def/codes/DIGGS/0.1/properties.xml). *format*: AGS4 format information the
converter reads; it is not data. *not converted*: with the reason.

Values are carried as reported. Units are renamed only through the unit table, and
nothing is converted numerically.

## Coordinate reference systems

`LOCA_GREF` names the CRS of `LOCA_NATE` and `LOCA_NATN`; `EPSG:<number>` is read as that EPSG code. `LOCA_LLZ` names the datum of `LOCA_LAT` and `LOCA_LON`. Any other value is reported, and nothing is guessed from the coordinates.

| AGS4 heading | AGS4 value | DIGGS srsName |
|---|---|---|
| `LOCA_GREF` | `OSGB` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/27700` |
| `LOCA_GREF` | `OSGB36` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/27700` |
| `LOCA_GREF` | `British National Grid` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/27700` |
| `LOCA_GREF` | `ITM` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/2157` |
| `LOCA_GREF` | `Irish Grid` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/29903` |
| `LOCA_LLZ` | `WGS84` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326` |
| `LOCA_LLZ` | `WGS 84` | `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326` |
